svg.title: Study B: shared frozen draft and matched continuation arms
svg.desc: R03/R04 design. Generate and freeze draft D. A read-only constructor proposes a public check and expected outcome using at most one file read. Run the check on D at most once, with a 30-second timeout, when available. C and F share D, the public issue, the check specification and the expected outcome. Only F receives the precomputed output or unavailable notice in advance. Both arms have the same tools and budgets, fresh contexts, matched seed, and no draft conversation history.

g.text: Fresh contexts | matched seed | no draft conversation history
Both arms may inspect, edit, and run checks.
